title: Italy Eats the Most Pasta. Guess Who's Number Two #didyouknow #facts
description:
Tunisia eats about 17 kg of pasta per person a year, second only to Italy (about 23.5 kg), ahead of Venezuela, France and Germany (EU pasta makers' figures reported by Euronews, 2023).
